title: Magnetoresistance effect of nitrogen doped graphdiyne
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37628-37632
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07434C, Paper

Huifang Kang, Yi Zhong, Peiyan Gao, Xiong Liang, Huiye Qiu, Yongping Zheng
This investigation elucidates the influence of nitrogen doping (N-doping) on the magnetoresistance (MR) characteristics of graphdiyne (GDY) by methodically adjusting the levels of N-doping.
